description: Investigate an email address — MX and syntactic validation, Gravatar lookup, corporate email-format inference, breach exposure, and full mail-header analysis covering the Received chain, Message-ID and SPF, DKIM and DMARC results. Use for email OSINT, verifying whether an address exists, finding accounts registered to it, guessing a company's email format, or tracing where a suspicious message actually came from. Applies to business email compromise and invoice-fraud investigation, phishing triage, vendor-payment verification, and pre-engagement research.
